architecture_note: Substituted for MobileViT — no MobileViT pretrained weights load under Keras 3 (keras.applications lacks it; TF-Hub is TF1-format; HuggingFace needs tf_keras, which failed here on checkpoint reload; keras_cv_attention_models' MobileViT applies a raw TF op to a KerasTensor). FastViT was the only lightweight transformer of 15 swept in that package that builds under Keras 3. See PROJECT_PLAN.md decisions log.
finetune_blocks_note: FastViT_T8 exposes 10 blocks vs 16 for both CNNs, so K is not directly comparable across architectures. The CNNs at K=3 unfreeze 18.8% (MobileNetV2) and 19.4% (EfficientNetB0) of their layers, which falls between FastViT's K=2 (15.4%) and K=3 (28.0%) — no integer K matches them. This run used K=2: 38/246 layers (15.4%).
finetune_blocks_note_superseded: FastViT_T8 exposes 10 blocks vs 16 for both CNNs, so K is not directly comparable across architectures. K=2 is the proportional match to the CNNs' K=3; K=3 unfreezes ~29% of layers. This run used K=2 (38/246 layers).
